diagnosis.narrative: The series shows no clear long-run trend. There is little seasonal structure. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (68 points, ~15% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.337), which favours a weighted combination.
